chunks: Then he sought to turn them out of the land, but We drowned him and all his followers.

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the land (specifically Egypt in this context)
key_terms.يَسْتَفِزَّهُمْ: to drive them out / to expel them

ai.seo_question: What did Pharaoh try to do to the Israelites and how did Allah punish him?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Isra, this verse highlights the culmination of Pharaoh's arrogance as he sought to uproot the Israelites from their land, only to be drowned along with his army. Shia exegesis often emphasizes this event as a divine retribution for his claim to divinity and his oppression of the believers, serving as a precursor to the night journey narrative.
